This bundle uses SDL 3 and SDL_ttf for desktop display, input and fonts.
It includes the dependency libraries listed in bundle.json. Their notices
and licenses are in this directory; source locations are in SOURCES.txt.

Portions of this software are copyright 2026 The FreeType Project
(https://freetype.org). All rights reserved.

The GNU LGPL libraries are dynamically linked. Bundled copies may be replaced
with compatible builds; no bundled runtime restriction prevents replacing or
modifying those libraries. Their upstream source is available through the
source links in SOURCES.txt and the upstream projects:
GLib: https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/glib
GNU gettext: https://www.gnu.org/software/gettext/
GNU libiconv: https://www.gnu.org/software/libiconv/
Graphite2: https://github.com/silnrsi/graphite

The libraries' macOS load paths and ad-hoc signatures were adjusted during
packaging. The library implementations were not modified by lcom-ng.
